title: sfx1021: Sidecar mods without the remote pages
description: External voice machines (PLAITS, DAISYSP, JUNO, FM, DIGIDRUM, DSP SAMPLE and user machines) on every track, the SEND FX 1/2 pages (AMPLITUDE 2; TYPE and P1..P5 with the Sidecar's FX labels, stepped lists), and the SIDECAR folder in the sample browser. The same as rui1022 without the remote pages.
